'''2004 Illinois State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship in Illinois (2004). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Illinois
* '''Dates:''' 2004
